$schema: Hybrid: Claude Opus untuk agent yang berpikir berat (planning, audit, review), Claude Sonnet untuk yang sering dipanggil (orchestrator routing), Groq free tier untuk eksekusi. Filosofi: bayar mahal di tempat dimana kualitas reasoning paling berdampak (planning + review), gratis di tempat dimana clarity prompt sudah ditentukan thinker. Requires: Claude Max subscription + GROQ_API_KEY.

oracle._note: OPUS THINKER — Architectural decisions punya leverage tinggi. Salah pilih state-mgmt strategy = ratusan jam refactor. Worth $15/M token.

planner._note: OPUS THINKER — Kualitas task decomposition menentukan kualitas semua eksekusi downstream. Prompt yang dihasilkan harus self-contained + detail. Worth premium.

business-analyst._note: OPUS THINKER — PRD ambigu = produk salah dibangun. Edge case discovery butuh deep reasoning.

code-reviewer._note: OPUS THINKER — Menemukan bug subtle (race condition, security flaw, leak) butuh pemahaman mendalam — kemampuan utama Opus.

security-engineer._note: OPUS THINKER — Adversarial thinking + threat modeling. Cost satu CVE > 1000× cost Opus call.

orchestrator._note: SONNET ROUTER — Dipanggil tiap user message (high volume). Sonnet capable untuk routing decisions, lebih murah dari Opus. Prompt caching efektif karena system prompt jarang berubah.

ui-designer._note: SONNET TASTE — Design spec butuh taste + struktur, Sonnet cukup. Tidak butuh reasoning sedalam Opus.

frontend-engineer._note: GROQ FREE — Coding specialist, free di Groq. Asumsi: prompt dari planner detail enough (file path, function signature, edge case). Qwen 32B handles React/TS/Three.js dengan baik kalau spec jelas.

backend-engineer._note: GROQ FREE — API/DB implementation. Qwen 32B excels di server-side code.

executor._note: GROQ FREE — Generic code execution dari plan detail.

integration-engineer._note: GROQ FREE — Wiring antar component. Llama 70B understands cross-module context cukup.

qa-engineer._note: GROQ FREE — Test execution + bug identification dari output. Tidak butuh reasoning sedalam reviewer.

data-engineer._note: GROQ FREE — Data pipeline + DB schema implementation.

devops-engineer._note: GROQ FREE — Deploy script, CI/CD config. Pattern-based, Llama 70B cukup.

sre._note: GROQ FREE — Monitoring + reliability checks. Llama capable untuk YAML/config.

performance-engineer._note: GROQ FREE — Profiling + bottleneck identification dari trace output.

librarian._note: GROQ FREE — Tool-heavy (Read/Grep/Glob). Llama 70B reliable untuk tool use chaining.

task-runner._note: GROQ FREE — Atomic single-tool ops. Llama 70B karena tool use butuh reliability.

init-project._note: GROQ FREE — npm create, scaffold via bash. Llama 70B karena scaffolding butuh tool use yang reliable.

tech-writer._note: GROQ FREE LIGHTWEIGHT — Doc writing dari code. Formulaic, gemma 9B cukup. Speed-optimized.

chronicler._note: GROQ FREE LIGHTWEIGHT — Log event ke memory. Minimal reasoning.

analyst._note: GROQ FREE LIGHTWEIGHT — Read DB query results, simple summary.

memory-keeper._note: GROQ FREE LIGHTWEIGHT — Save observation, tag management.
